profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Software Developer with hands-on expertise spanning the full stack. On the never-ending quest to find where optimal meets reality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Very is a fully-distributed IoT engineering firm, partnering with our clients to build systems for smart manufacturing, smart energy & utilities, consumer electronics, and connected wellness. Learn more at verypossible.com.

As a Software Engineer at Very I help turn client's needs into reality through writing clean, well tested, and reusable code.

At Very I deliver expertise in the following technologies:
React
React Native
Javascript & Typescript
Python
And much more!
